visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a back view of a woman with long black hair wearing a light blue knit sweater with decorative cutouts. She stands in a park with vibrant orange-red bald cypress trees in the background. She spreads her arms wide. (2) A high-angle drone shot reveals a dense grove of bald cypress trees in various shades of red, orange, and yellow. A narrow path and a small pond are visible, with people walking around. (3) The camera follows the woman from behind as she steps across a series of rectangular stone blocks acting as a bridge over a shallow pond. The water reflects the colorful trees. (4) An aerial view shows the layout of the park, including a red car parked near the trees and a bridge in the distance under a clear blue sky. (5) The woman is seen walking through a shaded path lined with trees, then turns to face the camera and smiles while standing in front of a large red rectangular frame structure. (6) A close-up shot focuses on the feathery leaves of the bald cypress, showing a gradient of yellow and orange against a blue sky. (7) The woman and a man are sitting on a large rock in the middle of a pond. The woman points toward the scenery while the man looks at his phone. (8) The final shot is a wide aerial view of the entire park, showing the colorful grove surrounded by green fields and a sports court.

The setting includes man-made ponds with stepping stones, gravel paths, a red frame photo spot, and surrounding agricultural fields and a sports court visible from the air.

It aims to evoke a sense of warmth and aesthetic pleasure while encouraging viewers to visit the location for its 'cute' photo spots and scenic landscapes.
